$comment: Structural constraints for the contest-entry skill. A competition entry is judged on the slides (the deck is what is submitted and what a reviewer prints), so slides stay the majority, and the interactive pages are the evidence that the entry uses digital means — capped, because in a submitted PPTX every interactive page is a placeholder that a reviewer has to click out of. Exactly one quiz: the booklet is generated from quiz scenes, so zero scenes means no booklet at all, and two means two sets of questions in a deliverable that asks for one 随堂练习. The page budget the entry form states (ten to twelve pages) is deliberately NOT a sceneCount here — no skill in this repo caps total length, because a course's length follows its material; the budget rides in the skill body instead. Rendered into the outline prompt AND checked against the model's output; violations come back to the agent as a tool-result diagnostic so it can re-plan. See lib/server/agent-runtime/skills.ts.
